parameters.validator: Returns the error for the current text, or null when it is valid; it shows under the row.
parameters.autovalidateMode: When the row checks itself: on each edit after the first, or only when its Form asks.
parameters.prefix: The row's label, before the input.
parameters.placeholder: The words shown while the row is empty.
parameters.onSaved: Called with the text when the enclosing Form saves.
